## Production Workflow
Applies the reviewer verdict after the dedicated VK review conversation finishes. It reads the review transcript, extracts a strict approve-or-reject JSON result, stores that result back into Vibe Kanban as a review-attention record, and only if approved does it generate commit messages and queue merge entries for the reviewed workspace repositories.

This workflow is intended to be used in production. Review policy lives in n8n, not in VK. VK only receives the resulting review record and merge commands.
